title: Indian EV startup River raises $120M Series C to scale production, launch more models | TechCrunch
summary: Indian electric vehicle startup River on Wednesday said it had raised $120 million to scale manufacturing for its next phase of growth. The new round, Mani said, marked a shift in what investors were backing.
